title: 第922章 融合三倍时间流速第921章 我的房主段位比你高能让炼妖壶有所感应绝对是宝贝
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 夜玄轻笑，起身背着手开始在天池中闲逛。
他不紧不慢，默默感知炼妖壶的反应。
盗天鲲尊残魂紧随其后，面上依旧挂着那副优雅笑容，但心中却忐忑不安。
藏了多年的秘密，可不能被这小子发现！
天池最重要的宝贝——具备时间加速能力的那块天池核心，已经被提前转移，藏在一处极其隐蔽位置。
只要核心还在，她盗天鲲尊就有信心卷土重来。
至于自己会不会被夜玄灭掉…盗天鲲尊反倒没有那么担心。
“小友，可曾听闻魔陨之地？”盗天鲲尊忽然开口，声音带着几分意味深长。
夜玄忍不住侧头看了她一眼：“魔陨之地？”
“没错。”
盗天鲲尊凤眸中闪过一丝精光，“天倾浩劫一事，想必小友你应该听说过。”
“神秘存在入侵大陆，杀的各方势力丢盔卸甲，关键时刻，一位金色御兽师驾驭黄金奇兽挺身而出，率大陆众人族对抗，最终取得胜利的故事。”
“小友难道就不好奇，那些曾入侵大陆的神秘存在，其尸骸，都去了哪里？”
夜玄来了几分兴趣，“不妨说来听听。”
他挺好奇，那些曾误入流放之地的魔人族强者尸骸究竟埋葬在何处。
盗天鲲尊飘到夜玄身侧，声音压低几分：
“实不相瞒。”
“那些尸骸，大多被封印在魔陨之地深处。”
“其中不缺九阶御兽师强者…若是能进入其中，随便捡个九阶御兽师强者身上的宝贝，都足以让中高阶御兽师受用终身…”
“至于魔陨之地的入口，我知道在哪里。”
“小友你若是有兴趣，我愿与小友合作。”
“天下没有永远的敌人，你我不如化干戈为玉帛，自古以来，合作共赢才是王道，相信只要我能给你带来无法拒绝的利益，你我之间，还是能成为朋友。”
夜玄目光闪烁，不动声色道：
“前辈倒是会挑时机谈合作，关键时刻抛出如此一条消息，是怕我对你不利？”
盗天鲲尊坦然承认，声音平静，带着几分自嘲：“是的，我很惜命。”
“人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，如今你手握九阶御兽师打手，你说，我拿什么跟你斗？”
“只能抛出一些令你感兴趣的东西从而保命。”
盗天鲲尊破罐子破摔：
“只要你不杀我，天池中的宝贝，小友随便挑，看上什么拿什么，我绝无二话。”
夜玄闻言笑了一声：
“前辈倒是比我想象中要坦诚得多。”
“不过…”他话锋一转，“魔陨之地的事，前辈确定不是临时编出来保命的？”
盗天鲲尊冷哼：“我盗天鲲尊虽然不是什么正人君子，但还不至于用假消息糊弄人，魔陨之地的入口，我确实知道。”
夜玄没有接话，继续朝廊道深处走去。
同时，声音传至盗天鲲尊耳边：
“魔陨之地的事，我暂且记下，等我把前辈的天池逛完，再与前辈你细聊一番。”
盗天鲲尊心中暗松一口气，寻思着这小子只要心动，自己暂时就没有性命之忧。
可很快，盗天鲲尊再次提起一口气。
只因夜玄竟朝着天池第三层寒霜区域方向走去。
第三层寒霜区，冰天雪地，终年严寒，资源极度贫瘠。
除了冰雪和少数矿物，几乎找不到像样魔植。
妖兽种类也少得可怜，多为毒鬃妖兽群。
content_en:
Ye Xuan chuckled, stood up and started wandering around the Tianchi with his hands behind his back.
He took his time and silently sensed the reaction of the Demon Refining Pot.
The remnant soul of Lord Thief Kun followed closely behind, with that elegant smile still on his face, but feeling uneasy in his heart.
The secret that has been hidden for many years must not be discovered by this kid!
The most important treasure of Tianchi, the core of Tianchi with the ability to accelerate time, has been transferred in advance and hidden in an extremely hidden location.
As long as the core is still there, she, Tiantian Kunzun, is confident of making a comeback.
As for whether he would be destroyed by Ye Xuan... Thief Tian Kunzun was not that worried.
"Little friend, have you ever heard of the Land of Demonic Fall?" Lord Thief Kun suddenly spoke, his voice somewhat meaningful.
Ye Xuan couldn't help but glanced sideways at her: "The Land of Demonic Fall?"
"That's right."
A glint flashed in the eyes of Master Kun, the Thief of Heaven, "You must have heard of the Heavenly Catastrophe, little friend."
"Mysterious beings invaded the mainland and killed all the forces. At the critical moment, a golden beast master controlled a golden beast and stepped forward to lead the mainland's human race to fight and finally achieved victory."
"Aren't you curious, little friend, where are the corpses of those mysterious beings who once invaded the mainland?"
Ye Xuan became a little more interested, "Why don't you tell me and listen."
He was quite curious as to where the corpses of the powerful Demon Race men who had strayed into the place of exile were buried.
Lord Thief Kun floated to Ye Xuan's side and lowered his voice a little:
"It's true."
"Most of those corpses are sealed deep in the Demonic Land."
"There are many strong ninth-level beast masters among them... If you can enter it, just pick up any treasure from a strong ninth-level beast master, it will be enough for the middle and high-level beast masters to benefit from it for life..."
"As for the entrance to the Demonic Land, I know where it is."
"My little friend, if you are interested, I am willing to cooperate with you."
"There are no eternal enemies in the world. It is better for you and me to turn our hostility into friendship. Since ancient times, win-win cooperation has been the way to go. I believe that as long as I can bring you benefits that you cannot refuse, you and I can still become friends."
Ye Xuan's eyes flickered and he said calmly:
"Senior will choose the opportunity to talk about cooperation. Are you afraid that I will be disadvantageous to you by throwing out such a piece of news at a critical moment?"
Thief Tian Kunzun admitted frankly, his voice was calm and a bit self-deprecating: "Yes, I cherish my life."
"You are a swordsman, and I am a fish. Now you have a ninth-level beast master's thugs in your hands. What do you think I can do with you?"
"You can only survive by throwing out something that interests you."
Thief Tian Kunzun broke the jar and threw it:
"As long as you don't kill me, you can pick whatever you like among the treasures in the Tianchi. I won't have any objections."
Ye Xuan laughed when he heard this:
"Senior is much more honest than I thought."
"But..." He changed the topic, "Senior, are you sure that the incident in the Demonic Land was not made up temporarily to save your life?"
Lord Thief Kun snorted coldly: "Although I, Lord Thief Kun, am not a gentleman, I am not that good at deceiving people with false news. I do know the entrance to the Land of Demonic Fall."
Ye Xuan didn't answer and continued walking deeper into the corridor.
At the same time, the voice reached the ears of Lord Thief Kun:
"I'll write down the matter about the Land of Demonic Fall for now. I'll have a detailed chat with you after I finish visiting Senior's Tianchi."
Thief Tian Kunzun secretly breathed a sigh of relief, thinking that as long as this kid's heart moved, he would not be in danger for the time being.
But soon, Lord Thief Kun took a breath again.
Just because Ye Xuan actually walked towards the third layer of frost area in Tianchi.
The third layer of frost zone is a land of ice and snow, with severe cold all year round and extremely poor resources.
Except for ice, snow and a few minerals, it is almost impossible to find decent magic plants.
There are also very few types of monsters, most of them are poisonous mane monsters.
